item_IO70-NEW-01.defect: pre-check confirm(0) passed, then motor_disarm() re-wrote the permit LOW and re-read ENN; UNEXPECTED_ENABLE/NO_SAMPLE there was only printed, so the clear path still printed final-confirmation and zeroed the fault code
item_IO70-NEW-01.fix: re-run the same bounded disabled-side confirm AFTER disarm; mismatch / no-sample / still-transition keeps the latch and the non-zero fault code and never prints final confirmation
constraints_kept: stop-STEP + permit revoke are still executed first by disarm (not rolled back)
no recursive shutdown/state-machine call from the GPIO feedback path (confirm only does rt_pin_read + bounded sampling)
lock order unchanged: ss_lock -> (disarm's brief mot_lock), same as safety_force_shutdown()
bounded window is the existing DRV_FB_TRIES x DRV_FB_SETTLE_MS, not a latency-bound claim
motor_disarm() public return semantics unchanged (re-check chosen over propagating failure; motor.h untouched)
item_IO70-NEW-01.reproduced_before_fix: IO7d/IO7e FAIL on cd337b4 with the new cases: state=MANUAL_CLEAR fault=0 while flip_consumed=0, write_delta=1, pwm_delta=1

item_IO70-NEW-02.defect: the old line skipped the feedback condition entirely once an enable request was confirmed, so CUT_BY_HARDWARE / NO_SAMPLE still reported ready
item_IO70-NEW-02.fix: expect per confirmed request side: want = (req==PIN_HIGH) ? 1 : 0, then require safety_fb_now(want)==OK; armed + normal ENN LOW stays ready (no arm->start deadlock), CUT_BY_HARDWARE / PAD_MISMATCH / NO_SAMPLE refuse
unchanged: bit5 gate mask and runtime guard behaviour (review confirmed those were already correct)
